notes.title: Release Postponement Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued interest and support.

We previously announced that the Steam version of
G-MODE Archives+ "Shin Megami Tensei -20XX-" would be released on May 8, 2025.
However, due to longer-than-expected processing times, we regret to inform you that the release has been postponed.

Please rest assured that this delay is solely related to final release procedures, and we expect to launch the game in the very near future.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

The new release date will be announced as soon as preparations are complete.
For the latest updates, please follow us on our official X (formerly Twitter): @GmodePR

Thank you for your patience and continued support.
